title: DC-area forecast: More humid with shower chances today; looking cool and wet midweek
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Mostly cloudy today with a more humid feel and highs in the upper 70s to low 80s. Could see a few showers this morning, then scattered showers and a storm possible this afternoon.

What’s next? Sunshine is in limited supply this week. A few showers are possible Monday. Low pressure brings the likelihood of rain at times Tuesday into Wednesday with a gusty breeze and cool highs only in the 60s.

Today’s daily digit — 5/10: Mostly gray skies, kind of sticky, and some pesky shower potential. Blah. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Sunday): It's a mostly cloudy day with a bit of a muggy breeze, gusting near 20 mph at times. Afternoon highs reach the upper 70s to low 80s with a more humid feel (dew points in the mid- to upper 60s). A few showers are possible during the morning, especially north and west of DC. Scattered showers and a storm could develop during the afternoon. Confidence: Medium

Tonight: Scattered showers and a storm remain possible this evening before diminishing overnight. It's rather muggy until humidity drops a bit toward morning. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Monday): Mostly cloudy to start the work week. An occasional shower is possible but it may not end up too wet of a day. A cool breeze from the north and northeast helps limit highs to the low to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Showers and a storm become more likely during the evening and overnight. Remaining mostly cloudy with lows near 60. Confidence: Medium

❤️ How to support Capital Weather

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

This disturbed pattern continues with rain likely at times Tuesday into Wednesday. Both days could see a gusty wind from the northeast with highs well below average, probably only in the 60s. You might need to break out the long sleeves or light jacket for the first time in a while! Tuesday and Wednesday night lows drop back to the 60s. Confidence: Low-Medium

Thursday looks less wet, but clouds and a chance of showers may persist with highs held to the 60s again. Skies should brighten by Friday, when rain chances look lower with highs back up to near 70. Confidence: Low

DC weather history for September 20

Rain from the approach of the 1938 hurricane set a daily record locally, a prelude to the catastrophic impacts the storm would unleash farther north in New England.
